verdict.rationale: ANEF is a government digital-administration portal, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only a JavaScript shell behind an account and a Cloudflare challenge on the parent ministry site. There is no mention of an MCP server or any agent-facing interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
